statement: The v2, v3 and v4 benchmark schema readers require a nonzero fixture content identity or a distinct nonzero session manifest fingerprint in every measured Ladder baseline frame. Session evidence preserves zero fixture content identity and requires a nonzero world epoch, current serving and target serials, matching committed generations, latest-target readiness and no source or capture failure. Missing, malformed and overflowing authority metadata is refused; diagnostic captures may report unavailable or stale authority.
